description: QWE session context for product and repository workspaces.

hooks.command: bash -lc 'for p in "$PWD/.codex" "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"; do [ -f "$p/hooks/session-start.sh" ] && exec bash "$p/hooks/session-start.sh"; done; exit 0'
hooks.commandWindows: cmd.exe /d /c if exist ".codex\hooks\session-start.cmd" (call ".codex\hooks\session-start.cmd") else if defined CODEX_HOME (call "%CODEX_HOME%\hooks\session-start.cmd") else (call "%USERPROFILE%\.codex\hooks\session-start.cmd")
